breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 本身极少直接致死，但长期反复酸/胆汁反流可引发食管狭窄、消化道出血及Barrett食管，后者有极小概率恶变为食管腺癌；易与心绞痛混淆而延误心脏急救。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 通过生活方式调整联合PPI或P-CAB抑酸治疗，绝大多数患者症状可迅速缓解、食管黏膜愈合；但停药后易复发，难治性患者需评估抗反流手术或内镜治疗。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GBD 2021未将GERD单独列为直接死因统计（主要以患病率与伤残损失寿命年YLDs衡量，2021年全球YLDs超630万人年）；极少数死亡源于继发食管腺癌或严重狭窄出血。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国官方死因统计未单列GERD死亡人数；属高发慢性良性消化道疾病，重点防控并发症与误诊。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: GBD 2021估算2021年全球约8.26亿人患病（年龄标化患病率约9,838/10万），较1990年约4.51亿例增长超80%。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: GBD 2021显示1990–2021年中国GERD患病人数增长超60%，成人周烧心/反流症状患病率约3%–8%且随肥胖与老龄化持续上升。

non_drug_therapies_zh: 睡前3小时禁食，睡眠时抬高床头15–20 cm（而非仅垫高枕头），超重者减重
避免高脂、巧克力、咖啡、浓茶、薄荷、碳酸饮料及烟酒，避免穿紧身腰带
出现吞咽困难、体重下降、贫血或呕血等报警症状立即行胃镜检查；胸痛需先排查心源性缺血
药物依赖或合并明显食管裂孔疝者可评估腹腔镜胃底折叠术或内镜下抗反流黏膜切除术（ARMS）
clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 常规门诊抑酸维持治疗年费用约400–2,000元；若行腹腔镜抗反流手术，单次住院约15,000–30,000元。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 新型P-CAB类药物（如伏诺拉生、凯普拉生）在多项III期临床中显示对C/D级重度反流性食管炎的愈合率显著优于传统PPI；食管24小时pH-阻抗监测与高分辨率测压技术提升了对难治性非酸反流及功能性烧心的精准分型。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 约20%–30%患者对标准剂量PPI反应不佳（难治性GERD），弱酸/非酸反流与食管高敏感缺乏特效药; 2) 长期大剂量抑酸带来骨质疏松、肠道感染及微生态紊乱顾虑; 3) 停药后高复发率与缺乏无创低风险的永久性括约肌修复手段。

master.definition_en: Coloboma of macula - brachydactyly type B or Sorsby syndrome is a malformation syndrome characterized by the combination of bilateral coloboma of macula with horizontal pendular nystagmus and severe visual loss, and brachydactyly type B. The hand and feet defects comprise shortening of the middle and terminal phalanges of the second to fifth digits, hypoplastic or absent nails (congenital anonychia), broad or bifid thumbs and halluces, syndactyly and flexion deformities of the joints of some digits. Coloboma of macula - brachydactyly type B is inherited in a dominant manner.

master.definition_en: Platelet storage pool deficiency refers to a group of conditions that are caused by problems with the platelet granules. Platelet granules are tiny storage sacs found within the platelets which release various substances to help stop bleeding. Platelet storage pool deficiencies occur when platelet granules are absent, reduced in number, or unable to empty their contents into the bloodstream. The signs and symptoms include frequent nosebleeds; abnormally heavy or prolonged menstruation ; easy bruising; recurrent anemia ; and abnormal bleeding after surgery, dental work or childbirth. Platelet storage pool deficiencies may be genetic or acquired (non-genetic). They can also be part of an inherited genetic syndrome such as Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome, Chediak-Higashi syndrome, thrombocytopenia-absent radius (TAR) syndrome, and Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome. Treatment is symptomatic.
synonyms_en: combined alpha-delta platelet storage pool deficiency
Combined alpha-delta platelet storage pool deficiency
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 病原体直接侵袭脑实质及继发猛烈免疫炎症反应，在数小时至数日内引发弥漫性脑水肿、颅内压急剧升高、癫痫持续状态及脑疝压迫脑干生命中枢；未经及时治疗的单纯疱疹病毒1型(HSV-1)脑炎病死率极高（传统自然病程>70%），细菌性脑膜脑炎延误抗感染数小时即可致死。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 细菌性脑膜脑炎及HSV-1/VZV病毒性脑炎在急诊黄金时间窗内立即经验性予广谱抗细菌药与静脉阿昔洛韦可显著降低病死率并可治愈；但乙脑、肠道病毒等多数病毒缺乏特效抗病毒药，且重症患者易遗留癫痫或认知残疾。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 急性颅内感染黄金小时急救：(1) 怀疑脑炎/脑膜脑炎1小时内不待病原学结果，立即在血培养及（排除脑疝风险后）腰椎穿刺的同时或之后即刻启动经验性静脉抗感染：静脉阿昔洛韦(10 mg/kg q8h)覆盖HSV/VZV＋血脑屏障穿透性三代头孢(头孢曲松/头孢噻肟)联合万古霉素覆盖常见细菌性病原；(2) 合并惊厥持续状态或严重脑水肿颅高压时立即予甘露醇/高渗盐水脱水降颅压、控制癫痫发作及ICU气道保护；(3) 48小时内结合脑脊液mNGS二代测序精准降阶梯或加用抗寄生虫/自身免疫性脑炎鉴别治疗。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶

breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

master.name_en: overgrowth syndrome and/or cerebral malformations due to abnormalities in MTOR pathway genes
master.definition_en: A disease caused by mosaic gain-of-function (GoF) of several genes in the MTOR pathway (MTOR, PIK3CA, PIK3R2 and AKT3) are functionally the same despite significant phenotypic variability. These GoF variants result in overgrowth due to an over-activation of key genes in this pathway. The phenotypic variability is generally attributed to the mosaic fraction and affected tissue types. For example, macrocephaly is noted if the variant is identified in the brain, but non symmetric overgrowth of that limb is noted when the variant is only present in the affected limb. The pathologies of the affected tissue often reveal similar characteristics such as cellular overgrowth. However, this is not always the case especially with focal cortical dysplasia. At times the characteristics pathologies are not present in the tissue but sampling biases are an issue. FCD resections often involve a very small area and so a very small amount of tissue is available for pathology and it is not guaranteed that lesional tissue is sent. Therefore, having a single disease term which can encompass the phenotypic variability yet provide a unifying molecular diagnosis name makes sense given the common functional mechanism.
synonyms_en: overgrowth syndrome and/or cerebral malformations due to abnormalities in MTOR pathway genes

breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

master.definition_en: A rare primary vascular anomaly characterized by mostly fusiform, rarely saccular aneurysm of the superior vena cava. Patients can be asymptomatic or manifest mostly with dyspnea, chest pain, pain in the retrosternal region, hypotension, acute upper or lower respiratory tract infection symptoms and left arm paresthesias. It is usually incidentally detected due to the presence of mediastinal shadow in X-ray.
mondo_categories: congenital anomaly of superior vena cava
